Row.Text: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities to this city and all cities within 10 tiles. Must be built along a River.
"Architecture has recorded the great ideas of the human race. Not only every religious symbol, but every human thought has its page in that vast book."[NEWLINE]–Victor Hugo

Notre Dame is a mighty cathedral standing on the "Île de la Cité," an island in the Seine River in Paris, France. Built on the site of an older church, which was in turn built on the site of a Roman temple to Jupiter, Notre Dame is a magnificent example of gothic architecture and one of the greatest buildings standing. Construction of Notre Dame began in 1163 and took almost two centuries to complete.

Notre Dame is a massive stone building of square towers, flying buttresses, and tall spires. The exterior is decorated with delicate ribbons of arches and statues of saints and kings. The roofline of the building is festooned with gargoyles. The interior of the cathedral is a long, narrow space with columns lining each side, supporting two beautiful raised galleries. Brilliant stained glass windows shine gently down on the main altar, which contains a beautiful statue of the Virgin Mary, the cathedral's patron, holding the body of Jesus.

The cathedral has suffered many periods of neglect over the years. During the French Revolution, many of Notre Dame's treasures were stolen and the building was used as a warehouse. In the early 1800s, the cathedral was in such a state of disrepair that the city planners contemplated tearing it down. In fact, Victor Hugo wrote "The Hunchback of Notre Dame" in part to raise awareness of the cathedral's plight. In 1871, during the short-lived Paris Commune, Notre Dame was almost set on fire. Fortunately the cathedral survived it all, and has now been largely restored to its original grandeur.

On 15 April 2019 at 18:50 local time, the cathedral caught fire, causing the collapse of the spire and the oak roof. Both towers were safe. The extent of the damage was initially unknown, as was the cause of the fire, though it was speculated that it was linked to ongoing renovation work.
French President Emmanuel Macron said approximately 400 firefighters helped to battle the fire. One firefighter was seriously injured during the blaze.

Many artifacts were saved before the fire spread to other parts of the cathedral. Because of the ongoing renovation, the copper statues that were normally on the now collapsed spire had been removed from the building a week prior. The stone vaulting which forms the ceiling of the cathedral remained largely intact, preventing the burning timbers falling into the building below.

The billionaire François-Henri Pinault announced plans to pledge €100 million towards renovation and called for a joint effort to fund repairs. Soon after, LVMH owner and billionaire Bernard Arnault and his family pledged another €200 million for the restoration of "this extraordinary cathedral, which is a symbol of France, of its heritage and of French unity".

Replace.Text: 为10个单元格以内的所有市中心提供+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值和+2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须建在临近河流的单元格中。
建筑记录了人类所有的伟大理念：不仅包括每一种宗教符号，还包括人类思想史的每一页。[NEWLINE] ——维克多·雨果
圣母院是座落于法国巴黎塞纳河上的“西岱岛”上的一座宏伟的大教堂。它的原址是一座由罗马的朱庇特神庙改建的古老教堂。巴黎圣母院是一座典型的哥特式建筑，也是世界上仍存在的最伟大的建筑之一。圣母院的建造从1163年开始，前后将近用了200年才完成。
圣母院是一座石质建筑，由许多的方塔，飞拱和高耸的尖顶组成。其外表装饰有许多拱形带和圣徒们与国王们的雕像，屋顶的轮廓饰有怪兽状的滴水口。大教堂的内部是一个又长又窄的空间，四周的圆柱支撑着两幅漂亮的浮雕。彩色玻璃窗轻轻地照耀在主祭坛上，在这个祭坛上有一座圣母雕像，她的怀中则抱着耶稣——这座大教堂由此得名。
这座大教堂在历史上遭遇过多次劫难。在法国大革命时代，圣母院中的许多财产被窃，并被征用为仓库。在19世纪初，这座大教堂的荒废景象使得城市的规划者考虑将它拆除。事实上，维克多·雨果撰写《巴黎圣母院》的部分目的就是希望唤起人们对圣母院的困境的关注。在1871年，在短命的巴黎公社执政期间，圣母院几乎被焚毁。幸运的是，圣母院从这一系列的遭难中幸存下来，现在已经基本上恢复了原有的宏伟。
2019年4月15日当地时间18:50，大教堂着起大火，导致尖顶和橡木屋顶倒塌。两座塔都很安全。损害的程度目前未知，火灾的原因也是未知，尽管据推测，这与正在进行的翻新工作有关。
法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙说，大约有400名消防员协助灭火。一名消防员在大火中受了重伤。
在大火蔓延到大教堂其他地方之前，许多文物被保存了下来。由于正在进行的整修工作，一周前倒塌的尖顶上的铜像被移走了。大教堂天花板的石质拱顶基本上保持完好，防止燃烧的木材落入下面的建筑中。
亿万富翁弗朗索瓦-亨利·皮诺宣布，计划以1亿欧元的资金进行翻修，并呼吁共同努力为维修提供资金。不久之后，路易威登的所有者、亿万富翁伯纳德·阿诺特（Bernard Arnault）及其家人又承诺2亿欧元，用于修复“这座非凡的大教堂，它是法国的象征，是法国传统和法国统一的象征”。
